D/ CRISPVS NOB CAES ; R/ VITRVS EXERCIT

A complete copper-alloy nummus of the Roman period from the reign of Crispus as a Caesar under Constantine I (AD316-326). RIC VII no. 297, Trier. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: CRISPVS NOB CAES. Reverse description: Trophy standing on ground with a bound captive either side. VOT XX on banner. Reverse inscription: VITRVS EXERCIT. Mintmark: T / F // STR…
